$comment: Rule for excluding our own traffic from scripts/d1-stats.mjs. D1 events store no IP or user agent, so test traffic is identified by player id and by time. A player is 'test' if ANY of: (1) its first-ever event is before `launchAt` (pre-launch dev/QA on workers.dev and the new domain); (2) its id is in `playerIds`, or it owns a session in `sessionIds` (live E2E runs log their session ids to redesign-shots/*/live-e2e.jsonl); (3) its first-ever event falls inside a `windows` entry (our post-deploy live checks, screenshot sweeps and launch-kit captures, taken from merge times and artifact mtimes), or within `mergeWindowMinutes` after any merge to origin/main (every merge auto-deploys and is followed by a live smoke check). Times are UTC+8. Real visitors who arrive inside a window are excluded too: this is a deliberately conservative filter. Add new windows/ids here when you test against prod.

windows.why: hero v2 deploy #61 + live CTA checks (redesign-shots/hero-v2)
